items.title: APT-C-20 Hackers Hide Shellcode in PNG Images to Launch Fileless C# Backdoor
items.description: A well known hacking group has found a clever way to sneak malicious code past security tools, using an ordinary picture file. The group, tracked as APT-C-20 and known as APT28 or Fancy Bear, hides shellcode inside PNG images to launch a fileless backdoor written in C#. items.title: New HalluSquatting Attack Could Trick AI Coding Assistants Into Installing Botnet Malware
